purpose: fixed-camera, fixed-presentation review contract for comparing ART-010 source, DCC, imported, and runtime captures without conflating those evidence stages

observed_2026_09_25.lesson_used: manual metering can hold a fixed exposure value; technical comparison captures should avoid view-dependent exposure drift
post exposure and grading can alter final brightness and tone; matched technical captures should hold them fixed or disabled

external_reference_basis.reference_boundary: workflow lessons only; no Epic or Unity content is copied and no parity is claimed

capture_profile.output_color_note: record actual runtime/DCC output transform; do not assume identical tonemapping across tools
capture_profile.comparison_rule: same camera transform, same field of view, same review material intent and fixed presentation settings for every compared stage

grazing_normal_check.purpose: make flipped normals, tangent discontinuities, coplanar z-fighting and seam gaps visually obvious

shots.intent: show complete front wall, centered opening, scale, front seams and both front corners
inspect doorway silhouette and front-wall shading from inside the room
inspect rear center seam, left wall seam and intentional rear-left corner overlap under grazing light
inspect right wall seam and intentional front-right corner overlap under grazing light
inspect all four floor modules, the cross-shaped seam network and one-repeat-per-metre UV scale if a checker review material is available

geometry: no visible crack along declared flush seams at matched source positions
no visible z-fighting on coplanar or intentionally overlapping corner geometry
no inverted-face disappearance with backface culling enabled
doorway remains visibly centered, 1 m wide and 2 m high
floor remains visually planar without transform-induced steps
shading: neutral material response is consistent across coplanar modules
grazing-light review shows no flipped normals
tangent discontinuities are limited to authored face/UV seams rather than random module corruption
review lighting does not hide geometry failures with a creative grade
uv: if a checker diagnostic is substituted, one authored UV repeat per metre is preserved
no unintended mirrored orientation is introduced by import conversion
UV evidence is diagnostic only and does not convert the neutral material into final production surfacing
scene_readability: doorway is readable from the front establishing shot
room scale reads consistently across exterior and interior shots
technical captures avoid depth-of-field, motion-blur or lens effects that conceal seams

allowed_evidence: Blender or other authorized DCC viewport/render using the pinned source
Astral import receipt and persisted imported asset data
native Astral captures from the matched shot contract plus command/build receipt
independent visual review against matched captures and this contract

review_record_requirements: repository commit and exact source pins
actual lighting settings or unsupported note
cleanup time or correction count if a defect is found

not_claimed: UE5, Unity, Genshin Impact or Zenless Zone Zero parity
